jobs.title: Personal Trainer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Werde Teil unseres dynamischen Teams als Personal Trainer*in und unterstütze unsere Mitglieder dabei, ihre Fitnessziele zu erreichen.

Von Personal Trainern bis zu Verkaufsteams, von der Zentrale bis zu SPA-Managern – Ihre Karriere entwickelt sich hier weiter. Als Teil unseres Teams profitieren Sie von exklusiven Vorteilen auf Produkte, Dienstleistungen und Merchandise von Holmes Place – von Merchandising-Artikeln über Services bis hin zu SPA-Behandlungen und Personal Training. Bitte beachten Sie, dass wir nur Bewerbungen berücksichtigen können, die über unser Online-Tool eingehen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

Entra a far parte del nostro dinamico team come personal trainer e aiuta i nostri membri a raggiungere i loro obiettivi di fitness.

Dai personal trainer ai team di vendita, dalla sede centrale ai manager SPA – qui la sua carriera continua a crescere.

- Come membro del nostro team, potrà usufruire di vantaggi esclusivi su prodotti, servizi e articoli di merchandising di Holmes Place – dagli articoli di merchandising ai servizi, fino ai trattamenti SPA e al personal training.
- Tenga presente che possiamo prendere in considerazione solo le candidature inviate tramite il nostro strumento online.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

Join our dynamic team as a personal trainer and support our members in achieving their fitness goals.

From personal trainers to sales teams, from headquarters to SPA managers – your career continues to develop here.

- As part of our team, you benefit from exclusive advantages on products, services and merchandise from Holmes Place – from merchandising items and services to SPA treatments and personal training.
- Please note that we can only consider applications submitted through our online tool.
